stories.title: Burnham to reveal plans for AI unit to tackle wildfires after scorching summer
stories.summary: The UK government plans to create an AI Cobra unit to detect wildfires after a record-breaking hot summer and devastating blazes. The announcement also includes funding for specialised protective equipment and the deployment of military aircraft.

links.headline: Burnham to reveal plans for AI unit to tackle wildfires after scorching summer
links.excerpt: PM will also announce funding for specialised protective gear and the deployment of military aircraft The UK government is to create an AI Cobra unit to spot wildfires after this year’s record-breaking summer saw devastating blazes across the country.
